%pip install -q anywidget codelens-widget puzzle-widget steps-widget turtle-widget

Sandbox cell magic

import sandbox_widget
%%sandbox

variable = 'hello world'
print(variable)

Codelens cell magic

import codelens_widget
%%codelens

def insertion_sort(a):
    for i in range(1, len(a)):
        key = a[i]
        j = i - 1
        while j >= 0 and a[j] > key:
            a[j + 1] = a[j]
            j -= 1
        a[j + 1] = key
    return a

data = [5, 2, 9, 1]
insertion_sort(data)

Interactive plotting with Seaborn

from iplot_widget import iplot
iplot(data)
import seaborn as sns
sns.set_style({'style': 'darkgrid', 'palette': 'viridis'})

g.set_titles(col_template="{col_name}", row_template="{row_name}")
